Great App. I really like this app and it has a lot of bad reviews. I'd like to clear this up for people considering this app. 

1) This app only works on the iPhone 5S. This is purely because the iPhone 5S has apples new M7 processor. This is the hardware that calculates your steps/movements with very little impact on battery use. If you're not going to read te description first. Then DONT complain when you don't have the required hardware. If you're not going to bother to find out why it requires the 5S DONT complain. Bad reviews because of user error seriously damage an apps chances. This is a great app, simple and easy to use. 

2) When you load the app after installing it will already have the last 7 days worth of movement. The M7 records all movement over the last 7 days regardless if you're using an app that wants the data. That's why there is data for the app already there. 

Happy walking :-)
